Role: Senior Product Manager, AI Products (Auth)
Location: Hybrid, Seattle, WA
Level: Senior

Requirements:
- 5-7+ years product management with track record building agentic products
- Agentic AI developer credibility (understands agent ecosystem, writes code, APIs and SDKs)
- Identity and AI protocols: OAuth, OIDC, SAML, MCP, mTLS
- Proven 0-to-1 and feature-launch experience
- Product instincts on developer pain points and security friction
- Growth mindset with technical depth (API specs, data schemas, AI standards, GTM strategy)
- Influence without authority across engineering, design, marketing, developer relations, sales
- Passion for AI and identity

Preferred:
- Startup founder or early-stage experience (significant plus)
- B2C/B2B SaaS and developer-facing product experience

Responsibilities:
- Agent identity and access management
- MCP and agent interoperability
- Prototyping, backlog management
- Documentation and enablement assets
- GTM launch support
